kids_evidence: News app for adults' morning brief; category LIFESTYLE (store/apps/daily-pulse.json:30); Kids Category audit n-a (docs/store-policy/daily-pulse.md:47).

banner.where: lib/presentation/screens/today/edition_view.dart:216 (after the edition end card) and lib/presentation/screens/archive/archive_screen.dart:132 (after the 5th archive row)

interstitial.why: No AglAds.onTransition call in lib (grep: no hit); the spec removed the tab-switch interstitial (specs/daily-pulse.md:199, founder Q2 at :333). Keep it out: a five-minute morning brief is a quick session. Note agl_ads still preloads one (see blockers).

native.screen: lib/presentation/screens/lists/article_list.dart (ArticleListBody) - used by Bright side, World editions, Search and Topic screens
native.why: These are real scrolling feeds of publisher headlines (ArticleTile rows from ~40 RSS sources), exactly the news-feed case. Insert `const AglNativeAd()` as its own row after every 8th article. Recommendations: (a) HairlineList is a non-lazy Column, so cap at 2 natives per list to avoid firing many requests at once; (b) pass a flag so AlertsScreen (bright_side_screen.dart:41, hard news) shows none - brand safety next to tragedy headlines; (c) never inside the Today edition story sections, which the spec keeps ad-free (specs/daily-pulse.md:199).

rewarded.why: No quota, premium or IAP (grep premium|quota|in_app_purchase|paywall in lib: no hit). The only 'cap' is the reader's own morning hard-news cap, a wellbeing setting that must not be bought back with an ad. Nothing honest to reward.

blockers: pubspec.lock pins agl_ads at d5e5b72, which predates agl-manifest cb21ee5 (git merge-base --is-ancestor: not contained); run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before using AglNativeAd/showRewarded.

agl_ads AglAds.initialize() preloads an interstitial on every launch even if the app never calls onTransition (packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ads.dart:94 `unawaited(_loadInterstitial());`). Removing the onTransition call does not stop that request; agl_ads needs an opt-out (e.g. a configure flag) or the app keeps sending one unused interstitial request per launch.

store/ratings/daily-pulse.json does not exist, so tooling falls back to store/ratings/default.json:16 "advertising": false although the app ships AdMob; apps with ads that have their own file say true (e.g. store/ratings/TripNest.json:16). Not verified what App Store Connect currently holds.
